summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement dated the same day titled 'Notice of Board Meeting.' The notice states the board will meet on August 19, 2026 to consider and approve the unaudited interim results for the six months ending June 30, 2026, and its publication. This is a routine disclosure of an upcoming board meeting for interim financial results, with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, strategic reviews, or capital actions. No deal terms or transactional details are provided. The filing is purely administrative and forward-looking regarding standard financial reporting obligations.
